scripts.check: bun run check:root && bun run check:qrcc && bun run check:noter
scripts.test: bun run test:root && bun run test:qrcc && bun run test:noter
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd products/qrcc typecheck && bun run --cwd products/noter typecheck
scripts.build: bun run --cwd products/qrcc build && bun run --cwd products/noter build
scripts.postinstall: bun run --cwd products/qrcc postinstall:markuplint && bun run --cwd products/noter postinstall:markuplint
scripts.clean: find . -maxdepth 5 -name node_modules -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && bun install
